f.title: Scope: GPSP applies to post-marketing surveys and studies of prescription drugs
f.statement: The Ordinance sets the standards for the post-marketing surveys and studies that support re-examination and re-evaluation applications (excluding matters covered by the GCP Ordinance) and the matters that MAHs and foreign special-approval holders must comply with when conducting post-marketing surveys and studies of prescription drugs (医療用医薬品 under Article 14(1) of the Enforcement Regulations), excluding in-vitro diagnostics and drugs applied to the skin solely for diagnosis.

rows.quote: 第一条 　 この省令は、医薬品、医療機器等の品質、有効性及び安全性の確保等に関する法律（昭和三十五年法律第百四十五号。以下「法」という。）第十四条の二の二第二項及び第十四条の二の二の二第五項の規定により適用される法第十四条第三項（これらの規定を法第十九条の二第五項において準用する場合を含む。）並びに第十四条の四第五項及び第十四条の六第四項（これらの規定を法法第十九条の四において準用する場合を含む。）の厚生労働省令で定める基準のうち製造販売後の調査及び試験に係るもの（医薬品の臨床試験の実施の基準に関する省令（平成九年厚生省令第二十八号）に定めるものを除く。）及び医薬品の製造販売業者又は外国製造医薬品等特例承認取得者が医薬品、医療機器等の品質、有効性及び安全性の確保等に関する法律施行規則（昭和三十六年厚生省令第一号）第十四条第一項に規定する医療用医薬品（体外診断用医薬品及び専ら疾病の診断に使用されることが目的とされている医薬品であって皮膚に貼り付けられるものを除く。）について行う製造販売後の調査及び試験の業務に関して遵守すべき事項を定めるものとする。

rows.quote_en: Article 1. This Ordinance sets, among the standards prescribed by MHLW ordinance under Article 14(3) of the Act on Securing Quality, Efficacy and Safety of Products Including Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices (Act No. 145 of 1960; "the Act") as applied by Article 14-2-2(2) and Article 14-2-2-2(5) (including where applied mutatis mutandis under Article 19-2(5)), and Article 14-4(5) and Article 14-6(4) (including where applied mutatis mutandis under Article 19-4 of the Act), those relating to post-marketing surveys and studies (excluding those set by the Ministerial Ordinance on Good Clinical Practice for Drugs (MHW Ordinance No. 28 of 1997)), and the matters that a marketing authorisation holder of drugs or a foreign special-approval holder must comply with in relation to post-marketing survey and study activities it conducts for prescription drugs as prescribed in Article 14(1) of the Enforcement Regulations of the Act (MHW Ordinance No. 1 of 1961) (excluding in-vitro diagnostics and drugs intended solely for the diagnosis of disease that are applied to the skin).

f.statement: Definition that sets which activities GPSP governs: post-marketing surveys and studies are surveys or studies an MAH or foreign special-approval holder conducts to collect, detect, confirm or verify information on the quality, efficacy and safety of a drug, namely use-results surveys, post-marketing database surveys and post-marketing clinical trials.

f.title: Definition: use-results surveys (general, specified, comparative)
f.statement: Definition: a use-results survey uses information collected from medical institutions in routine practice to detect or confirm the incidence of diseases etc. caused by adverse drug reactions by type and information on quality, efficacy and safety. It comprises (a) general use-results surveys with no conditions on the users; (b) specified use-results surveys on users defined by conditions such as children, the elderly, pregnant or nursing women, persons with renal or hepatic impairment or long-term users; and (c) comparative use-results surveys comparing users and non-users of a specific drug.

f.title: Prepare written PMS procedures covering the eight required procedures
f.statement: To conduct post-marketing surveys and studies properly and smoothly, the MAH must prepare post-marketing survey and study procedures (SOPs) covering: (1) use-results surveys; (2) post-marketing database surveys; (3) post-marketing clinical trials; (4) self-inspection; (5) education and training of staff engaged in the activities; (6) outsourcing of the activities; (7) retention of records of the activities; and (8) any other procedures needed to conduct them properly and smoothly.
